title: Speaking — Starting early
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on starting early.

questions: What places are within walking distance of your home?
When are the streets near your home most lively?
Which part of the area would you show to a visitor?
Would you rather arrive early or just on time?
When is it difficult to be punctual?

part2.topic: Describe an occasion when arriving early helped you.
part2.closing: and explain why the extra time mattered.

questions: Why do expectations about punctuality differ between settings?
Can appointments made more flexible improve access to public services?
How has everyday life connected with starting early changed for people of different ages?
